analysis.summary: Invitation to Tender NB-2026-114 issued by the City of Northbridge for the supply, installation, and maintenance of 1,250 smart LED street lights, 1,250 control nodes, and 40 replacement poles across the Eastgate and Riverside districts over a 36-month contract term with an optional 24-month maintenance extension.

requirements.description: Tenderers must hold a valid electrical contractor licence issued by the State Electrical Safety Board.

evidence.excerpt: Tenderers must hold a valid electrical contractor licence issued by the State Electrical Safety Board.

requirements.description: Demonstrate at least three completed street lighting projects of comparable scope within the last five years.

evidence.excerpt: Tenderers shall demonstrate at least three (3) completed street lighting projects of comparable scope within the last five years.

requirements.description: Provide audited financial statements for the last two financial years.

evidence.excerpt: The tenderer must provide audited financial statements for the last two financial years.

requirements.description: Demonstrate a minimum annual turnover of 2.5 million.

evidence.excerpt: Minimum annual turnover of 2.5 million is required.

requirements.description: Provide a traffic management plan prior to any works on arterial roads.

evidence.excerpt: The contractor shall provide a traffic management plan prior to any works on arterial roads.

requirements.description: Submit proof of public liability insurance of not less than 10 million.

evidence.excerpt: Proof of public liability insurance of not less than 10 million must be included.

requirements.description: Provide performance security equal to 5% of the contract value upon award.

evidence.excerpt: Performance security equal to 5% of the contract value is required upon award.

requirements.description: Attend the mandatory site briefing on 8 January 2027.

evidence.excerpt: A mandatory site briefing will be held on 8 January 2027.

requirements.description: Submit a completed Schedule of Rates (Form F-3).

evidence.excerpt: Tenderers shall submit a completed Schedule of Rates (Form F-3).

requirements.description: Submit tenders electronically via the Northbridge eProcurement Portal.

evidence.excerpt: All tenders must be submitted electronically via the Northbridge eProcurement Portal.

requirements.description: Luminaires must be warranted for a minimum of 10 years.

evidence.excerpt: Warranty: luminaires shall be warranted for a minimum of 10 years.

deadlines.relatedRequirement: Attend the mandatory site briefing on 8 January 2027.

evidence.excerpt: A mandatory site briefing will be held on 8 January 2027.
Clarification questions must be submitted by 12 January 2027, 17:00 local time.
Tender closing date: 2 February 2027 at 14:00 local time.
Installation of the first 400 luminaires must be completed within 90 days of contract award.
Full installation shall be completed no later than 30 June 2027.

specifications.details: Rated between 40W and 120W with a minimum efficacy of 150 lumens per watt, IP66 ingress protection rating, and colour temperature not exceeding 3000K in residential zones.

evidence.excerpt: Supply of 1,250 LED luminaires rated between 40W and 120W.

specifications.details: Compatible with the City's central management system and compliant with data protection policy.

evidence.excerpt: Supply of 1,250 networked lighting control nodes compatible with the City's central management system.

specifications.details: 8 m height located in the Riverside district.

evidence.excerpt: Supply of 40 replacement poles of 8 m height in the Riverside district.

risks.title: Unconfirmed Estimated Contract Value
risks.explanation: The estimated contract value is pending confirmation by the Finance Committee, creating commercial uncertainty for tenderers.

evidence.excerpt: Estimated contract value: to be confirmed by the Finance Committee.

risks.title: Missing Annex D for Joint Ventures
risks.explanation: Clause 2.5 conditions joint venture participation on Annex D, but Annex D is missing from the list of annexes.

evidence.excerpt: Joint ventures are permitted subject to conditions described in Annex D.

risks.title: Unspecified Currency in Financial Criteria
risks.explanation: Financial requirements for turnover (2.5 million) and public liability insurance (10 million) do not state the currency unit.

evidence.excerpt: Minimum annual turnover of 2.5 million is required.

missing: Currency denomination for minimum turnover and public liability insurance
Annex D containing joint venture conditions
inconsistencies: Section 2.5 states joint ventures are subject to Annex D, but Annex D is not listed in Section 6 annexes.
